'''Helia''' (Japanese: '''ヒマリ''' ''Himari'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN079|Night and Day, You are the Ones!]]''. She is the grandmother of [[Soleil]] and a descendant of [[Sorin and Luno|Sorin]], the first liege of [[Eclipse Castle]]. Helia was the present day liege, until she passed down the title to Soleil.

Helia met {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] outside Eclipse Castle and told them about the [[Eclipse Festival]] before they realized that [[Chloe]] and her {{TP|Chloe|Eevee}} were missing. Helia met Chloe when she returned with [[Soleil]], having switched clothes. Helia was present with Soleil as she was about to become the liege of Eclipse Castle, only for the ceremony to be interrupted by [[Ilunas]] who had kidnapped Chloe, believing her to be Soleil. Helia watched Chloe and Soleil battle Ilunas, which saw Ilunas get defeated.

She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]''.
